scenarios.scenario: Switch to Home while the Modify expansion is pinned

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is pinned and remains open after a click in empty viewport space
the user selects the Home document tab
Home is displayed and the Modify additional command area is no longer visible
the user returns to the part document tab
the 3D Model ribbon is visible and the Modify additional command area is closed
the user opens the Modify additional command area
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
the Modify additional command area closes

scenarios.scenario: Switch ribbon tabs while an unpinned panel expansion is open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user selects the Sketch ribbon tab
the Modify additional command area closes
the full Sketch ribbon is displayed
the part remains visible
the part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Cancel the layout reset from the Options expansion

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the Options panel displays its additional commands
the user activates Reset UI Layout
a confirmation dialog warns that the UI layout will be reset to its default
the dialog offers Yes and No
the user clicks No
the confirmation dialog closes
the Tools ribbon remains visible
the Options additional-command area is closed

scenarios.scenario: Open customization from an expanded panel title

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is at the top
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user right-clicks the lower Modify title
the ribbon context menu is displayed
the Modify additional commands remain visible
the context menu offers "Customize User Commands"
the user chooses "Customize User Commands"
the customization dialog opens on its Ribbon tab
the target is "Part | 3D Model"
the Modify additional command area is closed
the user closes the customization dialog without making changes
the dialog closes and the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible
the Modify additional command area remains closed

scenarios.scenario: Dismiss the context menu of an expanded panel

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user right-clicks the lower Modify title
the ribbon context menu appears and the additional commands remain visible
the user presses Escape
the context menu closes
the Modify additional commands remain visible
the user clicks the lower Modify title
the additional command area closes
the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Select the current appearance from an expanded panel title

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is at the top
the ribbon appearance is "Normal"
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user right-clicks the lower Modify title and opens "Ribbon Appearance"
"Normal" is checked and the Modify additional commands remain visible
the user selects the checked "Normal" option
the menus and Modify additional command area close
the full ribbon remains visible with command labels

scenarios.scenario: Inspect an additional command context menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user right-clicks "Move Bodies" in the additional area
a context menu offers "Move to Main Panel"
the menu offers "Add to Quick Access Toolbar"
the Modify additional command area remains visible
the user presses Escape
the command context menu closes
the Modify additional command area remains visible
the user clicks the lower Modify title
the additional command area closes
the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Compare the expansion footer in full and temporary ribbon displays

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is at the top
the user opens the Modify additional command area
the additional area shows Move Bodies, Bend Part and Copy Object
its lower title strip shows a pin control and the Modify title
the user minimizes the ribbon to tabs
the user opens the temporary 3D Model ribbon
the user opens the Modify additional command area
the same three additional commands are visible
the lower title strip shows the Modify title without a visible pin control
the user clicks empty viewport space
the additional area and the temporary ribbon close
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs

scenarios.scenario: Switch ribbon tabs with an expanded command context menu open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user right-clicks Move Bodies in the additional area
its command context menu is visible
the Modify additional command area remains visible
the user clicks the Tools tab
the command context menu and Modify additional command area close
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user clicks the 3D Model tab
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area remains closed

scenarios.scenario: Close the Sketch Constrain area and its menu on a tab switch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the full Sketch ribbon is selected
the Constrain additional-command area is open
the user right-clicks Constraint Inference Scope in the additional area
the Constrain area context menu is visible
the Constrain additional-command area remains open
the user selects the Tools tab
the context menu and Constrain additional-command area close
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user selects the Sketch tab
the full Sketch ribbon is visible
the Constrain additional-command area remains closed

scenarios.scenario: Keep a pinned constraint expansion across sketch edit

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an existing sketch in the MCAD Software
the full Sketch ribbon is visible outside sketch edit
the user opens the Constrain panel additional area
Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are unavailable
the user clicks the unavailable Edit Coordinate System command
the additional area remains open and no command starts
the user pins the additional area
the user opens the existing sketch for editing
the Constrain additional area remains open and pinned
Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are available
the user finishes the sketch without editing it
the Constrain additional area remains open and pinned
Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are unavailable

scenarios.scenario: Move a custom command into and out of the expanded panel

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the Part Tools custom panel target is initially empty
the user opens Customize from Tools
the user adds 2D Sketches to the Part Tools target
the user confirms the customization
the 2D Sketches icon appears in the User Commands main panel
the user right-clicks that icon
its context menu offers Move to Expanded Panel
the user selects Move to Expanded Panel
the icon is absent from the main panel
the User Commands title offers an expansion control
the user opens the User Commands expansion
the 2D Sketches icon appears in the expanded area
the user right-clicks the expanded icon
the user selects Move to Main Panel
the expansion closes
the 2D Sketches icon returns to the main panel
the user reopens Customize from Tools
the user removes 2D Sketches from the Part Tools target
the user confirms the customization
the User Commands panel is removed

scenarios.scenario: Retain a custom command in its expanded area across a ribbon tab switch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the Part Tools custom panel target is initially empty
2D Sketches has been added to the Part Tools custom panel
2D Sketches has been moved into the User Commands expanded area
the user opens the User Commands expanded area
the 2D Sketches icon is visible in that area
the user selects the 3D Model ribbon tab
the Tools expanded area is no longer visible
the user selects the Tools ribbon tab again
the User Commands panel is collapsed and offers an expansion control
the 2D Sketches icon is absent from its main area
the user opens the User Commands expanded area
the 2D Sketches icon is visible in that area

scenarios.scenario: Close the Constrain expansion when finishing sketch edit

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` contains an existing editable `Sketch1`
the full Sketch ribbon is visible outside sketch edit
the user enters sketch edit from the model browser
sketch commands become available and the Exit group shows Finish
the user opens the Constrain additional-command area
Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are visible
the user selects Finish without changing sketch geometry
sketch edit ends and the part view returns
the Constrain additional-command area closes
the original part geometry remains visible
